functional_correctness.description: Evaluates whether the code meets the specified requirements and produces the correct output for the given inputs.

edge_case_handling.description: Assesses the solution's ability to handle edge cases that may not be immediately apparent but are important for robustness.

efficiency.description: Measures the time and space complexity of the solution, particularly under large input sizes as specified in the task.

robustness.description: Evaluates the code's resilience against invalid inputs and its ability to handle unexpected situations gracefully.

api_library_usage.description: Assesses whether the solution correctly uses appropriate APIs and libraries, if applicable, and adheres to best practices.

readability.description: Evaluates the clarity and maintainability of the code, including naming conventions and code structure.

error_handling_security.description: Assesses how well the code handles errors and potential security vulnerabilities, particularly 'footgun' scenarios.

maintainability.description: Evaluates how easy it would be to modify or extend the code in the future, including documentation and modular design.
